entries.principle: Keep essential subjects and text inside a square-format central safe area
entries.execution_guidance: Compose 1:1 frames so actions, faces and supers remain legible across social feeds

entries.principle: Translate product features into relatable personal advantages
entries.execution_guidance: Anchor salary-account benefits in everyday convenience, pride or financial agency rather than a perk list

entries.principle: Use rapid-fire micro-benefits with deliberate visual rhythm
entries.execution_guidance: Sequence short benefit beats using brisk cuts and animated text without sacrificing comprehension

entries.principle: Synchronise kinetic typography to audio inflections
entries.execution_guidance: Time transitions and supers to music accents or voiceover emphasis

entries.principle: Keep voiceover intelligible over subtle music beds
entries.execution_guidance: Mix crisp dialogue ahead of unobtrusive background sound

entries.principle: Use clean corporate graphics and a reassuring closing brand sign-off
